verdict: No paid campaigns are live; organic activity is the only pipeline source.
narrative: There was zero paid spend across all 28 days — no Meta, no Google — so every contact and opportunity in this period came through organic channels alone. Your Google Business Profile generated 81 direction requests over 25 active days, but produced zero calls, meaning people are finding your location without following through to contact you. Direction requests also dropped 64% in the most recent week, with the last three days showing no activity at all. A set of build milestones required before paid campaigns can launch — including landing pages, CRM setup, and conversion tracking — are being resolved now, and paid activity is targeted to go live by month's end. Once those are in place, you can expect a cost-per-lead to appear for the first time and a meaningful increase in trackable pipeline.

highlights.phrase: contacts recorded this period, all from organic sources with no paid spend active
Google Business Profile direction requests over 25 active days, with zero calls generated
website sessions this period, none of which converted to a tracked lead

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile visitors are navigating to your location but not calling — call rate is 0% across the full 28 days, and direction requests fell sharply this past week.
watch_item.fix: Profile optimisation is underway to add stronger call prompts and improve the action path for users who find you via maps.
